slides.headline: III Points at Mana Wynwood, Oct. 16 to 17
slides.body: The festival runs at Mana Wynwood with 13 stages and artists including Flying Lotus, Tokischa, Four Tet and Lil' Kim. It starts at 3 p.m. and tickets cost $159 to $599.

slides.headline: Halloween murder mystery dinner at Kimpton Surfcomber Hotel, Oct. 17
slides.body: Kimpton Surfcomber hosts an interactive dinner at 8 p.m. with assigned character roles, clues, craft cocktails and a three-course meal. Tickets are $193.75.

slides.headline: iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina at Kaseya Center, Oct. 17
slides.body: The show starts at 8 p.m. at Kaseya Center with Anuel AA, Myke Towers, Farruko, Manuel Turizo and Greeicy. Tickets cost $45 to $370.

slides.headline: Tini at Kaseya Center, Oct. 18
slides.body: Tini brings her Futttura World Tour to Miami at 8 p.m. It is the only U.S. stop on the year-long tour, and tickets cost $61 to $408.

slides.headline: Naia opens on Las Olas, Oct. 22
slides.body: Naia opens at 904 E. Las Olas Blvd. at 4 p.m. with dinner and happy hour in the former Mango's space. The restaurant serves Mediterranean dishes with Asian flavors.
